claim: Eugénie-les-Bains tourist office maps three signposted hiking loops from the town: Blue 3.3 km, Green 6.6 km, Red 7.2 km; plus Circuit de la Grave (8 km) and Circuit de la vallée du Bahus (15.1 km) from the former station.
quote: Blue Circuit: 3.3 km; Green Circuit: 6.6 km; Red Circuit: 7.2 km. Loop 3 (Circuit de la Grave): 8 km, starting from the former station near the bowling green. Loop 4 (Circuit de la vallée du Bahus): 15.1 km, same departure point.

claim: Aire-sur-l'Adour offers the Circuit des vallons des Arribaouts (6.7 km from the municipal park near the arenas) and the Sentier de l'Adour, an 80 km trail with a 7 km segment between Barcelonne-du-Gers and Gée Rivière.
quote: Circuit des vallons des Arribaouts: 6.7 km, beginning at the municipal park near the arenas. Sentier de l'Adour: An 80 km trail passes through the region for 7 km between Barcelonne-du-Gers and Gée Rivière, accessible to hikers, cyclists, and mountain bikers.

claim: Aire-sur-l'Adour is a stage on the GR65 / Via Podiensis (Camino de Santiago Le Puy route), 26 km from Nogaro and 17 km onward to Miramont-Sensacq, passing the UNESCO-listed Church of Sainte Quitterie.
quote: From previous stage (Nogaro): 26 km. To next stage (Miramont-Sensacq): 17 km. The town's Church of Sainte Quitterie is UNESCO World Heritage-listed.

claim: The Scandibérique (EuroVelo 3) is a 1,776 km waymarked cycling route inaugurated in 2018 running from Maubeuge to Roncevaux through France, with stages crossing the Landes department.
quote: La Scandibérique, est 1 776 km long, connecting Maubeuge in the Nord to Roncevaux in the Pyrénées-Atlantiques. Inaugurated in June 2018.

claim: The official Scandibérique heads Mont-de-Marsan → Dax (33 km west), but a CycloTransEurope variant via Saint-Sever creates a Chalosse loop using the former railway greenway — Aire-sur-l'Adour is not on the marked main route.
quote: From Mont-de-Marsan, the official marked Scandibérique route heads west toward Dax to reach Tartas. CycloTransEurope proposes a variant by Saint-Sever that creates a loop through the slopes of Chalosse, an agricultural region crossed by a rustic greenway installed on the site of a former railway line.

claim: The Voie Verte de la Chalosse is a 34 km greenway on the former Saint-Sever–Dax railway, slightly undulating, passing Montfort, Montaut and Mugron through woods, hills and meadows.
quote: Length: 34 kilometres. Follows the old railway route linking Saint-Sever to the spa town of Dax. Towns: Saint-Sever, Montfort, Montaut, Mugron. The route offers rural and green landscapes featuring woods, hills and meadows.

claim: The Voie Verte de la Chalosse surface is not paved (stabilised gravel), unsuited to road bikes, with recommended departure points at Hinx and Saint-Sever (Augreilh district); the central Hauriet section closes during pigeon-hunting season.
quote: The path is not paved and not well-suited for road bikes. The recommended departure points are at Hinx and Saint-Sever (Augreilh district). The central section around the commune of Hauriet is closed during the pigeon hunting season.

claim: Canoë Kayak Aturin in Aire-sur-l'Adour (rue de la Violette) rents kayaks (€15/half-day, €25/day), double canoes (€30/€45) and paddleboards (€10/1h, €15/2h) June–early September, with descents up to 14 km along the Adour.
quote: Single kayak: €15 (half-day) / €25 (full day). Double canoe/kayak: €30 / €45. Paddleboard: €10 (1 hour) / €15 (2 hours). Season: June through early September. Trip Distance: Up to 14 km in nature along the river.

claim: Canoë Kayak Aturin runs daily in July–August (otherwise by appointment) with a 7 km loop from the nautical base taking about 2.5 hours; swimming ability required.
quote: Open from June 1, 2026. The facility offers departures from the nautical base with a 7km loop taking approximately 2.5 hours. Rental is available every day in July and August, and by appointment the rest of the year. Swimmers must know how to swim.

claim: Les Greens d'Eugénie (Golf du Tursan) at Bahus-Soubiran is a 9-hole par-35 course (2,786 m, slope 133/126) designed by Jean Larrouy in 1996, about 2 km from Eugénie-les-Bains, with vineyard-lined fairways and a stream crossing.
quote: Holes: 9. Par: 35. Distance: 2,786 meters. Slope Ratings: 133 (men), 126 (women). Designer: Jean Larrouy. Established: 1996. Located in Bahus-Soubiran approximately 2km from Eugénie-les-Bains.

claim: Les Greens d'Eugénie is open daily 9:00–18:30 year-round, with a 12-station practice (6 covered), putting green, equipment rental, lessons and a clubhouse with panoramic-terrace restaurant.
quote: Open daily 9:00 AM–6:30 PM (throughout 2026). The course includes 12 practice stations with 6 covered bays and a putting green. Additional amenities feature a clubhouse with bar service and dining options, including a panoramic terrace.

claim: Domaine de Benquet at Le Houga (8 km from Aire-sur-l'Adour, just over the Gers border) is a Cheval Qualité France-labelled equestrian centre offering pony baptisms from age 3, trail rides, vaulting and lessons, open daily.
quote: 3763 route de Benquet, 32460 Le Houga. 8Km d'Aire sur Adour, à droite. Baptême de poney dès 3 ans, balades et randonnées, voltige, travail à pied, attelage, cours d'équitation et stage. Cheval Qualité France accreditation. Open daily 9am-6pm (Monday-Saturday) and 2pm-6pm on Sundays.
